title: Airfield Apron Reconstruction, Phased
scope: Concrete apron replaced in six phases while aircraft parking moves around the work. Each phase: close, demolish, subbase, pave, seal, mark, reopen.
assume: Apron 180 m × 46 m in six 30 m phases, six 7.6 m paving lanes, 5 m panels (slip-form, 400 mm PCC on 150 mm CTB).
Aircraft at a stand are relocated before closure and return after inspection; counter = available stands, minimum 5 of 6.
